## What's new
- **Give a model's memory back on request.** A loaded model holds many gigabytes of memory until Astronomical unloads it after a quiet spell. Programs and agents can now ask for that memory back at once with `POST /v1/control/unload-model` on the local API. The next request loads the model again. A reply that is being written is never interrupted: the request answers "busy" instead. - **The Astronomical skill tells agents about it,** so an agent that has finished its job can free the memory when you ask.
## Compatibility
- Your settings, conversations and downloaded models are kept. No setting changed. - Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
The app and disk image are signed with Developer ID, notarized and stapled by Apple, and the update feed is signed.
